review_scope: Read-only TC review of the exact H2 schema execution contract v2, its pinned ledger and new PostgreSQL test selectors. No tests, migrations, database, or service were executed.

resolution_of_v1_blocker.evidence: The test now asserts the reserved row starts as (NULL,NULL,NULL), exercises two partial windows against the named binding_start_window_shape CHECK with SQLSTATE CheckViolation, verifies the row remains unchanged after each rejected update, and then uses record_start_attempt to establish the valid complete window. This directly addresses PostgreSQL CHECK null semantics and keeps the accepted full tuple path.

coverage_review.migration_and_roles: The nine exact new IDs cover upgrade/backfill success and rollback for missing/ambiguous history, schema constraints, role registry/function ACLs, OID/name drift, membership/name drift, SCRAM without trust fallback, and real create-to-activation SQL.
coverage_review.independent_binding_digest: The activation test explicitly builds an 18-field expected binding document from fixture inputs and pinned registrations, canonicalizes it independently, and compares the domain-separated SHA-256 to the returned digest.
coverage_review.command_bytes_and_auth: The test keeps the established NUL→422/no-row behavior and separately exercises accepted lone-surrogate/astral/quote/backslash content through the immutable ASCII envelope. It checks real HTTP list/detail/command responses and idempotent 202 receipt while authorized, then verifies external 403 after membership/revocation changes while the authenticated internal SQL receipt remains identical.
coverage_review.workspace_generation_fence: A second accepted job is reserved/admitted, then its READY workspace generation changes; projection must quarantine without consuming the accepted command or creating a receipt. The first job’s already-applied receipt remains byte-for-byte/equality stable after its later generation change.
coverage_review.execution_window: The all-NULL, partial-NULL, unchanged-row and valid-population sequence satisfies the explicit SQL shape oracle and prior review blocker.
coverage_review.runner_and_scope: The contract pins the current ledger and implementation/static review, preserves the 351 archived IDs plus nine literal cases, requires 360 passing cases with no skips/timeouts and records the phase/case timing and real PostgreSQL cleanup checks. It explicitly does not claim Temporal dispatcher/worker execution, H1 recheck, full H2, or original AT acceptance.

execution_boundary: Approval is for the specified schema/SQL subgate only, and only after the separately required independent frozen-source/pre-gate review approves this exact contract and runner. This review is not evidence that any test or service has run or passed; Temporal integration and all original acceptance tests remain outstanding.
